newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Unilever buys Ecuador's top ice-cream maker.
newsitem.headline: Unilever buys Ecuador's top ice-cream maker.

text.p: Anglo-Dutch conglomerate Unilever has bought Ecuador's top ice-cream maker Pinguino, a senior Unilever official said Friday.

"We plan to invest $15 million within the next five years," Unilever General Manager for Ecuador Sigfredo Valle told Reuters. He declined to discuss the amount paid for Pinguino, which controls 70 percent of Ecuador's ice-cream market.
Valle said the purchase took place in late September.
"We hope to consolidate (our business) and export to other countries such as Peru and Colombia, where we also have Unilever subsidiaries," Valle said.
Unilever will keep Pinguino's 330 staff and plans to introduce new technology to improve production, which "currently has excellent standards," he said.
